dict.Cât se scade din impozit: How much is deducted from tax
dict.Contractele de sponsorizare ale anului c: The year's sponsorship contracts with the beneficiary, the amount, the payment and the proof of use; you get the status of each one (those whose beneficiary is not in the ANAF register in red), and on the right how much can be deducted from corporate income tax (the lower of 0.75% of turnover and 20% of the tax) and what is carried over to the following years.
dict.Contractul: Docs → Șabloane → Contract d: The contract: Docs → Templates → Sponsorship agreement.
dict.Nu se scad (beneficiarul nu e în registr: Not deductible (beneficiary not in the register)
dict.Plafoanele sunt cele pentru impozitul pe: The limits are those for corporate income tax; for micro-enterprises and for the following years, check them with your accountant.
dict.Rămâne de scăzut în anii următori: Carried over to the following years
dict.Sponsorizări plătite, cu beneficiarul în: Paid sponsorships, beneficiary in the register
dict.Un rând pe contract, un tabel pe an. La: One row per contract, one table per year. For “In the ANAF register”, check the beneficiary on the ANAF website on the contract date.
